response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT m.Name AS MediaTypeName, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS BytesPerMs FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT MediaTypeName, BytesPerMs, BytesPerMs / (SELECT AVG(BytesPerMs) FROM r) AS RatioToAverage FROM r

assumptions.assumption: The figure for each media type is the pooled ratio SUM(Bytes)/SUM(Milliseconds) over its tracks, not an average of per-track ratios.
An inner join to MediaType keeps only tracks with a matching media type. Media types with no tracks are excluded, and each media type counts once in the average.
Tracks with NULL Bytes are still included in the Milliseconds sum, because the request does not say to exclude them.

alternatives.interpretation: The figure for each media type is the average of the per-track Bytes/Milliseconds ratios, rather than the pooled ratio.
alternatives.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT m.Name AS MediaTypeName, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS BytesPerMs FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) SELECT MediaTypeName, BytesPerMs, BytesPerMs / (SELECT AVG(BytesPerMs) FROM r) AS RatioToAverage FROM r
